what.text: This page follows refugees from Côte d'Ivoire living in Liberia, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 970 Ivorian refugees in Liberia, 3.0% of all refugees from Côte d'Ivoire.
France hosts the most Ivorian refugees, followed by Italy, Germany and Liberia.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Ivory Coast from 2002 to 2004 and in 2011.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2011 and 2012, begin in the year of the second conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at 19158 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 128067, at the end of 2011, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Liberia.
These are year-end totals for Liberia only, reported to UNHCR.
